title: Converting a mixed number by adding all its numbers
statement: To write a mixed number as an improper fraction you add the whole number to the numerator and keep the denominator.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: convert a mixed number to an improper fraction

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items. A slip is a wrong product within the multiply-then-add method.

vs.math.frac.add-whole-to-numerator: Same surface result on 2 + 1/3, but this bug is triggered by mixed-number notation, not by a plus sign.
vs.math.frac.improper-impossible: Improper-impossible believers refuse to write 7/3 at all.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 4.NF.B.3: understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b

resolved_by.label: CCSS 4.NF.B.3: understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b
